tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Asymptotics in $L^\infty $-norm] ↗ thm:lax-oleinik-formula 1. ch3:3.4-thm-5\group Conservation Laws

There is $C$ such that \[ |u(x,t)|\le Ct^{-1/2}\qquad (x\in \R ,t>0). \]

Proof

\sketch Put $\sigma =F'(0)$, so $G(\sigma )=L(\sigma )=L'(\sigma )=0$. Uniform convexity gives $tL((x-y)/t)\ge \theta |x-y-\sigma t|^2/t$. Boundedness of $h=\int _0^xg$ forces every minimizer to satisfy $|(x-y(x,t))/t-\sigma |\le Ct^{-1/2}$. The Lax–Oleinik formula and the Lipschitz continuity of $G$ yield the result.

□

For the N-wave asymptotics, assume in addition that $g$ has compact support.
